references.disposition: The universally quantified existence and uniqueness of y for every x is the defining total, single-valued graph condition of the graph-only mapping. Cartesian product and subset are already linked. A bare graph does not uniquely determine the codomain even though this condition holds, and another same-mapping target would self-reference.

references.phrase: bare graph does not determine codomain Y

references.matching_note: Reviewed original source's polynomial expression with the common multivariate-polynomial construction.
